I will give a talk at the Prague algebra seminar on Monday, 9.3 at 15:40 Prague time on a recent formalization paper in Lean, related to this paper:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04376

The lecture will also be on Zoom. I will put a link here (a few minutes before the talk) if anyone is interested.
Here is the Zoom link. It starts in one hour. https://cesnet.zoom.us/j/93662994566?pwd=bIJLzurlAg4yiffjKseDU7mwd4yDNg.1
Congratulations! Would you like to add an answer to https://mathoverflow.net/questions/6719/is-projectiveness-a-zariski-local-property-of-modules-answered-yes ?
